remarks: Welcome home to 193 Rowayton Woods Drive, where contemporary design and resort style amenities nurture a high quality and convenient lifestyle. This two bedroom, one bathroom condominium with soaring ceilings, cozy fireplace, and private entrance set this home apart from the rest. Enter through your vaulted foyer and walk up to the main floor with sunny reading nook and spacious living area. Rich-toned luxury plank flooring throughout, a well appointed kitchen with updated stainless steel appliances, and a thoughtful floorplan bring together a wonderful blank slate ready for your interior designs and personal touches. Enjoy coffee, or a cocktail, on your secluded deck, followed by a stroll through the community to the tennis court or sparkling pool. Experience refined coastal living in the private, meticulously maintained, and highly coveted Rowayton Woods Condominium Association.
